title: Anchor's Kit System
description: AdvancedKitSystem provides a dual-tier kit economy for Minecraft. It offers free starter kits and Vault-integrated premium kits via a color-coded GUI, featuring UUID-based persistence and fully customizable YAML configurations.
body:
# 🎁 ADVANCED KIT SYSTEM ![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21%2B-green?style=for-the-badge) ![Dependency](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dependency-Vault-yellow?style=for-the-badge) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21-orange?style=for-the-badge) **Advanced Kit System** Is A High-Performance, Dual-Tier Kit Solution For Spigot And Paper Servers. It Allows Server Owners To Offer Standard **Starter** Kits Alongside High-Tier **Premium** Kits That Players Can Permanently Unlock Using Their In-Game Currency. > [!NOTE] > This Plugin Requires **Vault** And An Active **Economy Plugin** (Like EssentialsX Or CMI) To Handle Premium Kit Purchases. --- ## ✨ KEY FEATURES * **🎮 DUAL-TIER SYSTEM** * **Starter Kits:** Free, Cooldown-Based Kits For All Players. * **Premium Kits:** Economy-Gated Kits. Pay Once, Keep Forever. * **🎨 INTERACTIVE GUI** A Professional, Color-Coded Chest Interface: * 🟢 **Green:** Free Kit Ready To Claim. * 🔴 **Red:** Premium Kit (Locked Or Insufficient Funds). * 🟩 **Lime:** Premium Kit (Purchased & Available). * **⚙️ DEEP CUSTOMIZATION** Every Kit Is Configurable Via `kits.yml`, Including Custom Names, Lore, And NBT-Style Enchantment Strings. * **📊 SMART PERSISTENCE** Uses UUID-Based Tracking To Ensure Player Data And Cooldowns Remain Consistent Even If Players Change Their Usernames. --- ## 🕹️ COMMANDS & PERMISSIONS | Command | Description | Permission | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `/kits` | Opens The Main Kit Selection GUI | `advancedkits.use` | | `/kitadmin reload` | Reloads All Configuration Files | `advancedkits.admin` | | `/kitadmin give

` | Force-Gives A Kit To A Specific Player | `advancedkits.admin` | | `/kitadmin reset

` | Resets A Player's Kit Cooldown | `advancedkits.admin` | --- ## 🔧 CONFIGURATION PREVIEW The `kits.yml` Is Designed To Be Human-Readable And Easy To Modify: ```yaml kits: warrior: display-name: "&6&lWarrior Kit" type: PREMIUM price: 5000.0 icon: DIAMOND_SWORD slot: 13 cooldown: 86400 description: - "&7The Ultimate Combat Gear." - "&ePrice: $5,000" items: - "DIAMOND_SWORD 1 SHARPNESS:5 NAME:&cBlood_Shedder" - "DIAMOND_CHESTPLATE 1 PROTECTION:4"
